author: acc_maraquinn
title: @maraquinn: Why I'll be cheering on Monday

versions.body: A long one, friends. I used to think saving the Mill meant saving Eastfield. I was wrong. Eastfield is people, not bricks. On Monday the council can give 1,200 families a home. I'll be cheering. 💛
Proud of my city today 💛

fixes computers. lives in ridley. mostly offline now.
